preconditions.description: The input string n is non-empty.
The length of the substring is within the bounds of the length of n.

postconditions.description: The output n is a non-empty string of digits without leading zeros.
The output n contains the input substring.

postconditions.expression: all(n[i] <= n[i+1] for i in range(len(n) - 1))
postconditions.description: The digits in n are in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: int(n) is the smallest possible integer that satisfies Q1, Q2, and Q3
postconditions.description: The output n is the smallest possible integer that contains the input substring and has non-decreasing digits.
